item.title: Solved How to Flatten a List of Lists in Python
item.description:
“Solved How to Flatten a List of Lists in Python”

This guide explores various approaches to flatten lists in Python, from elegant list comprehensions to powerful tools from the itertools and numpy libraries, along with custom recursive and iterative solutions. We will delve into their practical implementations, performance characteristics, and ideal use cases to help you choose the most suitable method for your specific needs.

Method 1: Python’s Nested List Comprehension

The nested list comprehension is often the most Pythonic and highly regarded method for flattening a list of lists, especially for single-level nesting. It provides a concise and readable way to iterate through sublists and collect their elements.
